title: Why Travis Etienne is the Saints' new X-Factor on offense | FULL BREAKDOWN
text: The New Orleans Saints made Travis Etienne one of the NFL's highest-paid running backs in total value. Nick Underhill turns on the film and breaks down the in-depth stats to explain why the Saints saw Etienne as the answer on offense. 01:40 The Big Question: Will Etienne make or break the Saints' offense? 08:40 The stats that back up the contract 17:30 Film Review 38:35 What does Etienne's presence mean for Alvin Kamara? 41:30 Reacting to Etienne's offseason press conference 50:00 Projecting Etienne's 2026 stats 56:58 What is the Saints' biggest weakness?

title: [FULL EPISODE] What is fair and unfair criticism of Caleb Williams?
channel_name: Take The North: A Chicago Bears Podcast
text: Dan Wiederer is on vacation, so our friend Mark Potash sits in with Mark Grote for this one! The guys dive into a deep conversation on Bears quarterback Caleb Williams. Have we been too critical of him at times? What's fair criticism of Williams? Also, the guys play a game called "Is It Enough?" – specifically looking at the additions the Bears made this offseason. Did they do enough to improve their roster?
